subject: Strategic MAP + 21-day Evaluation Timeline for Brightlane
messages:
From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Lopez <sara@brightlane.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 3 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Strategic MAP + 21-day Evaluation Timeline for Brightlane

Hi Sara —

Thanks again for the call this morning. As promised, I’m sharing a compact MAP (mutual action plan) canvas we use to keep trials focused and to shorten time-to-decision. The doc includes a 21-day evaluation timeline, roles & owners, success criteria (tech + business), and a lightweight procurement checklist.

What I’m asking for from your side:
- Quick review of the owners and dates (line items I highlighted in yellow)
- Confirm acceptance criteria for model quality (latency/accuracy thresholds) and security blockers
- Call out any procurement constraints (PO timing, security questionnaire owners) so we can align the start date

I’ve attached a copy and also left an editable Google Doc so we can co-edit: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aBcD_eXAMPLE-MAP-TEMPLATE

Attachments: [MAP_template_v1.gdoc (Google Doc)] [Brightlane-eval-checklist.xlsx (Excel)]

Proposed next steps:
1) You review and drop comments by EOD Thu (6/5)
2) Quick sync (30 min) Fri 6/6 to lock owners and pilot start
3) Kickoff week of 6/9 if procurement aligns

If this timeline is aggressive, tell me where to stretch — we’ll adapt.

— David
David Kim
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
redwood.ai | (415) 555-0192

From: Sara Lopez <sara@brightlane.ai>
To: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Brightlane Procurement <procure@brightlane.ai>
Date: Wed, 4 Jun 2025 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Strategic MAP + 21-day Evaluation Timeline for Brightlane

Thanks David — this looks useful and very clear. A few quick notes from our side:

- I moved the security review owner to Lila (copied procurement) and set the expected completion date to 6/13; our internal SOC2 evidence pull takes a little time.
- For acceptance criteria: can we add an explicit latency p95 target (<= 250ms) and a qualitative QA pass rate threshold (>= 92% on the seed prompts)?
- Procurement: PO timeline likely 2–3 weeks; we’ll try to expedite for a pilot PO but can’t promise earlier than 6/20.

I left comments in the doc (see highlighted sections). I can join the sync on 6/6 at 11am PDT.

On Wed, Jun 4, 2025 at 09:12 AM David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Thanks again for the call this morning. As promised, I’m sharing a compact MAP...

Sara Lopez
Head of Product, Brightlane
https://brightlane.ai

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Lopez <sara@brightlane.ai>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 5 Jun 2025 08:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Strategic MAP + 21-day Evaluation Timeline for Brightlane

Sara — great comments, thank you. I added a short 'technical acceptance' checklist to the doc, including:
- Baseline dataset for seed prompts (owner: Brightlane Eng)
- Quantization/profile we plan to run on Dedicated for throughput tests (owner: Redwood Infra)
- Ramp plan: 1k reqs/day -> 10k/day over the first week if the pilot passes initial gates

I also created a slide stub that summarizes the MAP (2 slides) so Brightlane execs can see the timeline quickly.

Attachments: [MAP_2-slide-summary.gslides (Google Slides stub)]

I’ll be on the 6/6 11am sync and will bring the slide deck.

— Marissa
Sr. Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Lopez <sara@brightlane.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Brightlane Procurement <procure@brightlane.ai>
Date: Fri, 6 Jun 2025 11:36:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Strategic MAP + 21-day Evaluation Timeline for Brightlane

Thanks all for the quick turn. Confirming the sync at 11:00am PDT today — agenda: 1) owners & decision gates, 2) acceptance criteria alignment, 3) procurement runway and go/no-go date.

Two small updates before the call:
- I incorporated Sara’s latency/QA thresholds into section 2 of the doc and added a simple scoring table so we can mark pass/fail per gate
- I dropped an acceptance item for data retention (Brightlane to confirm retention window for logs) — that will impact our suggested caching policy

If procurement can’t get a PO before 6/20 we will still run the pilot in a limited ‘no-card’ evaluation mode using Redwood hosted credits; we’ll keep production throughput gated behind a PO.

See you at 11.

— David

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 6 Jun 2025 15:23:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Post-sync notes — Brightlane MAP next steps

(Internal only) Quick recap from today’s call with Brightlane:

- Agreed start: target pilot kick (pilot in-hosted eval mode) week of 6/16; formal pilot (with PO/dedicated capacity) contingent on PO timing
- Owners: Brightlane Eng (seed prompts + dataset) | Lila (security evidence) | Marissa (Redwood infra + slides) | David (commercial owner)
- Decision gates: 7-day tech validation (gate 1), 14-day scale & app integration (gate 2), final exec sign-off on day 21
- Action items:
  * David: update MAP with scoring table and share final link (done)
  * Marissa: upload 2-slide summary to shared drive and prep infra runbook
  * Jordan: coordinate trial credits and add monitoring hooks in the console for Brightlane token-level cost visibility
  * Sara/Lila: post security evidence by 6/13, procurement to confirm PO timeline by 6/12

I attached the slide stub and checklist we iterated on. Moving to the shared MAP doc now for final comment close.

Attachments: [MAP_2-slide-summary.gslides] [Brightlane-eval-checklist.xlsx]

— Jordan
Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
